'''Luur''' was one of the [[Deity/Legends|deities]] of the [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] religion. He was believed to have been created by the goddess [[Sri'quay]] after [[Sri'quay'va]] upset the balance of heaven by creating a number of worshippers. Eventually, Luur was challenged by [[Quay'va]], a creation of Sri'quay'va, and killed.<ref name="LoNH" />
